generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the palm base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the palm program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 2, 2nd ed., 1959), family 393 Palmae: stems often clothed in the bases of old leaves, the leaves in a cluster at the top (scattered in climbing palms), whole or divided pinnately or palmately; flowers small and regular, in an often paniculate inflorescence among or below the leaves, with one to many spathes; perianth double, three sepals and three petals; stamens usually 6, rarely many; ovary superior, of three carpels, free or joined; fruit a berry or drupe. The stems' wood is the palms' own, with no secondary growth; they are counted woody, as the floras call them trees.
